title: Custom Icon System
slide_intent: Coordinate functional symbols so people can recognize actions without relearning a visual language.
strategic_value: Consistent green linework can connect Sweetgreen’s ordering and location tools to its wider identity.
demonstration: Four panels group Food, Utility, Social Media and Map symbols, each with a row of five examples.
practical_value: Compare line weight and form across task groups while preserving recognizable third-party social symbols.

content_islands.name: Food and utility
content_islands.spec: Use the upper two panels for food-related symbols and general actions.

content_islands.name: Social and map
content_islands.spec: Use the lower panels for platform marks and location symbols; retain group labels.

reference_purposes.Intent: The Custom Icon System caption links unified stroke weight and form to functional clarity across app and signage.
reference_purposes.Expression: Green linear symbols share restrained detail across the four groups.
reference_purposes.Application: The panel labels assign icons to food, utility, social and mapping contexts.

ingredient.name: Functional green icons
ingredient.role: Support recognition of tasks and destinations.
ingredient.application: Coordinate stroke and form across the shown functional groups; preserve the identity of social platform marks.
ingredient.scope: Case-study specimens, not a complete production icon specification; no stroke measurement is supplied.
